newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO chooses 8 firms in electricity supply tender.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO chooses 8 firms in electricity supply tender.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Thursday it had chosen eight electricity suppliers, including General Sekiyu KK and Showa Denko KK, from whom it will buy a total of 1.1 million kilowatts for 15 years.
The eight will start supplying electricity to TEPCO sometime between 1999 and 2001, a company spokesman said.
The other selected firms are Ebara Corp, Hitachi Ltd, Hitachi Zosen Corp, Polyplastics Co Ltd, Nippon Petroleum Refining Co Ltd and Tomen Corp.
Nippon Petroleum is a subsidiary of leading Japanese refiner Nippon Oil Co Ltd, and Polyplastics is affiliated with Daicel Chemical Industries Ltd.
The eight were selected from 31 bidders in TEPCO's first such tender. It plans to issue another tender next year to buy about one million kw of electricity starting in 2002, the spokesman said.
